column7: SIGKILLing the postmaster mid-write (the only event that can lose an async commit on Postgres) leaves a clean TAIL loss and a chain that still verifies. MANUAL by construction: it kills a database server, so it is gated on KX_FASTAUDIT_PG_CRASH_CONTAINER and skips in every automated run. Artefact: the run recorded in FASTAUDIT-1's PR body -- 70 acknowledged async commits, 3 lost as a clean tail starting at #67, VerifyAuditChain VALID over the 67 survivors
